messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] GPU OOM spike on cluster 'west-2-gpu' — detected repeated container restarts on runtime pool 'prefill-rt'. Incident ID INC-6182. Auto-page: carla (oncall).

carla: ack, I'm on it. seeing 3x restarts on gpunode-54 within 2m.

sam (runtime): logs from container:
```
E/CUDA: out of memory when allocating 1.1 GiB
Stack: runtime/prefill.cc:482 allocate_kv_cache
Container restarted by kubelet: OOMKilled
``` 

carla: looks like prefill blowup — incoming request with ~1.2M tokens. prefilling KV cache spikes memory then kernel reset.

ben (infra): I'm cordoning gpunode-54, draining pods to hotpool. taking node out of rotation.

sam (runtime): mitigation options: 1) temporarily drop prefill for requests >256k tokens (short-circuit) 2) route large-context requests to fallback-quantized model (lower mem) 3) enable strict KV eviction on prefill path.

carla: short-term: enable short-circuit >256k and route to fallback-quant. Leah, CS — any customer visible impact?

leah (customer-success): two customers (acct: acme-ai, beta-chat) reported 503s and degraded latency. I've opened tickets and notified them we're mitigating. No PII exposed.

deploy-bot: Applied config patch r=/deployments/runtime/flags change: prefill_max_tokens=256000, fallback_model=redwood-lite-q2 (canary on 10% nodes)

sam (runtime): canary looks good, no OOMs on canary nodes for last 5m. rolling to 50%.

ben (infra): node gpunode-54 drained and rebooted, will monitor for hardware/kernel errors. No kernel die found so far.

carla: moving to post-incident: create followup docs: root cause: large single-request prefill allocating > expected KV cache; remediation: throttle prefill, add request-size limits at edge, improve KV prefetch heuristics. action items assigned: sam -> KV eviction patch PR (#4218); ben -> node health check & kernel logs; leah -> customer comms.

carla: handing off to ben for overnight monitor. Ben you're oncall next. Please update thread with status.

ben: ack handoff, will watch alerts for 6h and escalate to eng-sre if recurring.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED by carla. Duration 00:32:43. Incident severity: Sev3. Postmortem assigned: PM-INC-6182
